works.body:
Hi there! Your artwork looks so amazing!! I saw this posts and others and was absolutely charmed with your talent and style!

https://skeb.jp/@MELUNACANTUS/works/2

I would be honored if you accepted an art request for my OC, Xivern! He is a guildmaster to a large fantasy adventuring guild! He is a fun loving, tactical leader who is confident in his abilities during combat and skilling in fighting. But also greets everyone he meets with a big, warm smile and not being afraid to be silly and have a good time.

A background isn't necessary but would I be able to get a transparent background version as well? I plan to use this art within my social community and twitch/Youtube content. All proper credit will be attributed if used.

I love the way you do gestures and would love to see him in a combat pose. Maybe using his sword? But I want to leave everything up to you for pose, expression, and clothing condition! Thank you so much for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1c7dcgJPCzZewhUVhsTD5T7LHLtkfrxbk?usp=sharing

Hello!

Would it be possible to get an illustration of my character/VTuber? Please draw her in whichever pose you wish!~
However I would like a special request where one of her hands is pointing like a gun!

If I could get files with and without the background that would be perfect!

Some more details include: she has a flower on the right side of her hair, it is a red Carnation flower. The red is dark crimson, and her eyes are a lovely colour of purple! Her hair is a gradient going from a dark hazel to crimson. She is a somewhat shy but kind witch.

I may use your work for a phone wallpaper or SNS!

Here is the best references I have of her.
https://imgur.com/kOBksU1
https://imgur.com/nSnapsO
https://imgur.com/YiNIPEC

Thank you so much! I look forward to the finished piece (╯▽╰ )
